KEY_EXCHANGE.tradeoff: Public key ~1.2 KB vs 32-256 B today; slightly larger handshake, comparable speed

SIGNATURE.tradeoff: Signatures ~3.3 KB vs ~64 B for ECDSA; use SLH-DSA for very long-lived signatures

AES_128.tradeoff: Negligible cost; hardware acceleration makes AES-256 nearly as fast

BROKEN_HASH.tradeoff: Slightly slower than MD5/SHA-1, but not a real bottleneck

BROKEN_CIPHER.tradeoff: Modern authenticated encryption; needs a code change, not a big performance cost
